title: SecondBrain backup manifest v1
description: manifests/<yyyymmdd>t<hhmmss>z[-N].json. Status: DESIGN_REVIEW contract; no implementation is asserted.
$comment: Structural checks only. A conforming parser and semantic validator must additionally: (1) reject duplicate JSON keys, a BOM, NaN/Infinity and non-UTF-8 input before schema validation; (2) enforce that created_utc is a real calendar date-time (format is an annotation unless a format checker is enabled); (3) require entry paths to be unique and to have no case aliases (equal under case folding); paths are relative with no absolute form, drive letter, backslash or '.'/'..' segments (the patterns exclude them, the check is repeated for defense); (4) for object entries require the two-hex directory to equal the first two characters of the file digest, and sha256 to equal that digest; (5) for config entries require the file digest to equal sha256; (6) for receipt entries require the id in the path to have a valid UTC calendar timestamp, and its hash8 to match the first 8 characters of the referenced receipt's sha256; (7) require set closure: the object entries are exactly the objects referenced by the receipt entries; (8) require the file's own name to be a valid manifest name and exactly one config entry (also expressed below with contains/minContains/maxContains); (9) verify every payload hash and size against the stored files; (10) choose the newest manifest by parsed timestamp then numeric suffix, never lexicographically.
